answer: Every agent identity must lock a refundable stake that is released only after sustained honest attestation. Creating one haven account is cheap, but a tide of fake identities each needs its own locked stake, so the capital cost scales linearly with the number of Sybils while honest work earns the stake back. At the nadir of an attack, forged accounts that misbehave are slashed and their stake is burned, so the attacker loses real money for every identity that gets caught.
